desc: Varginha is a city of roughly 130,000 in southern Minas Gerais, Brazil, and the location of the most widely reported non-US recovery claim of the modern era: the January 1996 episode in which multiple civilian witnesses reported an anomalous creature and in which Brazilian military and fire service personnel were said to have participated in a capture and transfer. Its significance to this board is structural rather than evidentiary - Brazil transferred substantial military UFO holdings to the Arquivo Nacional, making the state's own records citizen-accessible in a way the United States has not matched, so the Varginha case is testable against an open archive. In July 2026 a US congressman formally requested FBI and CIA holdings relating to the incident, making it a live American oversight matter three decades after the fact.
